description: This file defines an exception class MappingIdNotLinkedToPocketException used within the self pockets feature of the Fineract platform, specifically related to domain rule violations when a mapping ID is not linked to a pocket.

classes.name: MappingIdNotLinkedToPocketException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating that a mapping ID is not linked to a pocket, extending the platform's abstract domain rule exception.

methods.name: MappingIdNotLinkedToPocketException
methods.description: Constructor that passes specific error codes and messages to the superclass to create a domain rule violation exception.
